en.body:
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-webbridge

Kimi WebBridge host plugin: model tools that drive the user's REAL browser
(navigate, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, screenshot, network inspection,
tab management) through the local `kimi-webbridge` daemon at
`http://127.0.0.1:10086`.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Prerequisites

The daemon and browser extension install independently:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://cdn.kimi.com/webbridge/install.sh | bash
```

Then install the Kimi WebBridge browser extension and let it connect to the
daemon. Check readiness: `kimi-webbridge status` (look for
`"extension_connected": true`).

## Model Experience

### Model view

#### What the model sees

Eleven `webbridge_*` tool schemas, each with a `session` argument naming the
current task (one task = one tab group):

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `webbridge_navigate` | Open a URL (new tab or current), set the tab group label |
| `webbridge_find_tab` | Re-select a tab this task opened, or borrow the user's active tab |
| `webbridge_snapshot` | Read the page's accessibility tree (text + `@e` refs) |
| `webbridge_click` | Click an element by `@e` ref or CSS selector |
| `webbridge_fill` | Type into inputs / textareas / contenteditable editors |
| `webbridge_evaluate` | Run JS in the page (async supported) |
| `webbridge_screenshot` | Capture the page or one element to a file path |
| `webbridge_list_tabs` | List the tabs opened in the session |
| `webbridge_network` | Inspect network activity (start/stop/list/detail) |
| `webbridge_close_tab` | Close the current tab of the session |
| `webbridge_close_session` | Close ALL tabs of the session (clears the whole tab group) |

#### Sessions and closing rules

These rules come from the upstream skill and are part of the model contract:

- **One task = one session = one tab group.** Pick one `session` name at the
  task's start and keep it on EVERY call — never switch mid-task, even across
  sites (switching is the #1 cause of fragmented tab groups).
- **Name it after the task**, not the site (`camping-research`, not
  `kimi.com`).
- **`group_title`** is the human-readable group label, set on the FIRST
  `navigate` of the task, written in the user's language.
- **Announce the group once.** When the first `navigate` creates the group,
  tell the user that this task's pages are collected under group «title» and
  that you'll close them whenever they ask.
- **Closing is always user-initiated.** Call `webbridge_close_session` ONLY
  when the user explicitly asks to close/clear the tabs. Never close tabs
  automatically at the end of a task — the user decides when to dismiss them.

#### Token effect

Each call is one HTTP round-trip to the local daemon; the returned payload is
summarized to a compact one-line `summary` plus the raw `detail`. Snapshot
and evaluate results can be large (page trees, JS returns) — the shared
output schema caps the inline text to the summary.

#### KV Cache effect

None: browser state lives in the user's browser, not in the model request.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- **`event.isTrusted`** — sites that strictly check trusted input (some
  banking portals, captchas) ignore synthetic `click`/`fill`; the daemon's
  `cdp` escape hatch is not exposed as a tool yet.
- **Cross-origin iframes** — snapshot/click/fill/evaluate operate on the top
  frame only.
- **Screenshots** — the daemon writes to a temp path and returns the path;
  the model must use a Read tool to view the image.
- **Daemon down** — tools fail loud with a `daemon_unreachable` error telling
  the user to run `~/.kimi-webbridge/bin/kimi-webbridge start`.

## Configuration

The daemon address defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:10086`. Tools accept no
plugin config today; the `baseUrl` seam exists for tests.

zh.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-webbridge
zh.summary: Kimi WebBridge 主机插件：模型工具驱动用户的真实浏览器（导航、快照、 点击、填写、求值、截图、网络检查、标签页管理），经由本机 kimi-webbridge 守护进程（http://127.0.0.1:10086）。
zh.body:
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-webbridge

Kimi WebBridge 主机插件：模型工具驱动用户的**真实浏览器**（导航、快照、
点击、填写、求值、截图、网络检查、标签页管理），经由本机
`kimi-webbridge` 守护进程（`http://127.0.0.1:10086`）。

[English](README.md) | 中文

## 前置条件

守护进程与浏览器扩展需单独安装：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://cdn.kimi.com/webbridge/install.sh | bash
```

然后安装 Kimi WebBridge 浏览器扩展并让其连接守护进程。就绪检查：
`kimi-webbridge status`（应看到 `"extension_connected": true`）。

## 模型体验

### 模型视角

#### 模型看到的内容

十一个 `webbridge_*` 工具 schema，每个都带 `session` 参数命名当前任务
（一个任务 = 一个标签组）：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|------|------|
| `webbridge_navigate` | 打开 URL（新标签或当前标签），设置标签组标签 |
| `webbridge_find_tab` | 重新选择本任务打开的标签，或借用用户当前活动标签 |
| `webbridge_snapshot` | 读取页面的无障碍树（文本 + `@e` 引用） |
| `webbridge_click` | 按 `@e` 引用或 CSS 选择器点击元素 |
| `webbridge_fill` | 在输入框 / 文本域 / contenteditable 编辑器中输入 |
| `webbridge_evaluate` | 在页面中运行 JS（支持 async） |
| `webbridge_screenshot` | 截取页面或单个元素，输出到文件路径 |
| `webbridge_list_tabs` | 列出会话中打开的标签页 |
| `webbridge_network` | 检查网络活动（start/stop/list/detail） |
| `webbridge_close_tab` | 关闭会话的当前标签页 |
| `webbridge_close_session` | 关闭会话的所有标签页（清空整个标签组） |

#### 会话与关闭规则

以下规则来自上游 skill，是模型契约的一部分：

- **一个任务 = 一个会话 = 一个标签组。** 任务开始时选定一个 `session`
  名，并在**每次**调用中保持不变——切勿中途切换（哪怕是跨站点），
  切换是标签组碎片化的头号原因。
- **以任务命名**，而非站点（如 `camping-research`，而不是 `kimi.com`）。
- **`group_title`** 是人类可读的标签组标签，在任务的**第一次**
  `navigate` 时设置，用用户的语言书写。
- **告知一次标签组。** 当第一次 `navigate` 创建标签组时，告诉用户该任务
  的页面归在组「标题」下，且用户说一声即可关闭。
- **关闭永远是用户发起的。** 仅在用户明确要求关闭/清理标签时调用
  `webbridge_close_session`。切勿在任务结束时自动关闭标签——何时关闭由
  用户决定。

#### Token 影响

每次调用是对本地守护进程的一次 HTTP 往返；返回载荷被压缩为一行
`summary` 加原始 `detail`。快照和求值结果可能很大（页面树、JS 返回值）——
共享输出 schema 将内联文本限制为 summary。

#### KV Cache 影响

无：浏览器状态存在于用户浏览器中，不进入模型请求。

## 已知限制与暂缓事项

- **`event.isTrusted`** —— 严格检查可信输入（部分银行门户、验证码）会
  忽略合成的 `click`/`fill`；守护进程的 `cdp` 逃生口暂未暴露为工具。
- **跨域 iframe** —— snapshot/click/fill/evaluate 仅作用于顶层 frame。
- **截图** —— 守护进程写入临时路径并返回路径；模型需用 Read 工具查看图片。
- **守护进程未运行** —— 工具以 `daemon_unreachable` 错误响亮失败，并提示
  用户运行 `~/.kimi-webbridge/bin/kimi-webbridge start`。

## 配置

守护进程地址默认为 `http://127.0.0.1:10086`。工具目前不接受插件配置；
`baseUrl` 接缝为测试而保留。
